# Getting Started {#getting-started}

These three pages take you from nothing to a working terminal emulator, in the
order you'll need them. If you only want a parser or an encoder, read the first
page and then go straight to @ref api_building_blocks "Building Blocks" or @ref
api_input "Input".

- @subpage installing - Get the library and link it into your program.
- @subpage first-terminal - Create a terminal, write bytes into it, and read the
  screen back.
- @subpage building-a-terminal - Connect a pty, a renderer and a keyboard to the
  library.
